Thick smog covers Metro Manila's skyline as seen from Taytay, Rizal, on Sunday, April 12, 2026, following a fire at the Navotas Sanitary Landfill. 

Local government units, including Manila City, advised residents to remain indoors and wear N95 masks as air quality reached unhealthy levels. (📷John Louie Abrina/MB)

LANDFILL FIRE WORSENS AIR QUALITY 

Residents across parts of Metro Manila are being advised to limit outdoor exposure after the Navotas landfill fire worsened air quality over the weekend.

READ: https://t.co/m9HXWCcUDd https://t.co/7JL0vwTkL1

Napansin n’yo bang mausok sa Metro Manila?

Umabot sa “acutely unhealthy” ang Air Quality Index sa ilang lugar sa Metro Manila nitong Sabado, Abril 11, matapos masunog ang tambakan ng basura sa Navotas.
